shortDescription: RRC Southern Railway has invited online applications for 4471 Trade Apprentice posts. Apply online from 28 August 2026 to 27 September 2026.
content:
Railway Recruitment Cell RRC Southern Railway (SR) has released the notification for Southern Railway Apprentice Various Trade Recruitment 2026 under Advertisement No. CPB/P1/98/Act/TP/Vol.XXI.

Eligible candidates can apply online from 28/08/2026 to 27/09/2026. Read the official notification for trade-wise eligibility, workshop-wise vacancies, age limit, selection procedure and other details.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 28/08/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 27/09/2026
  • Exam Date / Merit: As per schedule

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS: ₹100
  • SC / ST / PH: ₹0

Pay the examination or application fee through the prescribed online or offline fee mode.

Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 15 years
  • Maximum Age: 22 years for Freshers
  • Maximum Age: 24 years for Ex-ITI
  • Age is calculated as on 28/08/2026

Vacancy Details

  • Trade Apprentices Freshers: 163
  • Trade Apprentices Ex-ITI: 4308
  • Total: 4471 posts

Eligibility

  • Freshers: Class 10th / 12th with minimum 50% marks as applicable.
  • Ex-ITI: Class 10th / Matric with ITI or NCVT certificate in the related trade.

Check the official notification for the complete workshop-wise and trade-wise vacancy distribution before applying.
